pages.text: CALL runs a function. PARAMETER lines give it values, RESULT lines say which variable gets which result. Results you don't list are thrown away.
$(1)CALL greet$(br)  PARAMETER name "c0de" ;$(br)  RESULT result greeting$()
Here $(1)greeting$() becomes "Hello, c0de!". A function can only call functions that are defined above it, or itself.
